name: Future bass trap snap
desc: Halftime trap-derived future bass drums: booming 808 kick with syncopated pickups, layered snare+clap snap on beat 3, and hi-hat rolls that ply into triplet-feel bursts. Full opens the hats with saw velocity; peak stacks 16th rolls and ghost snares. Flume/San Holo bounce.

code.full: stack(s("<[bd ~ ~ ~] [bd ~ [~ bd] ~]>").bank("RolandTR808").shape(.45).gain(${gain}), s("~ ~ [sd,cp] ~").bank("RolandTR808").shape(.3).room(.35).gain(${gain}*.85), s("hh*4").bank("RolandTR808").ply("<1 2 1 <2 4>>").gain(saw.range(${hats}*.5, ${hats}).fast(2)), s("~ ~ ~ [~ oh]").bank("RolandTR808").gain(.35)).every(${fill}, x=>x.fast(2)).orbit(1).play()
code.peak: stack(s("<[bd ~ [~ bd] ~] [bd [~ bd] ~ ~]>").bank("RolandTR808").shape(.5).gain(${gain}), s("~ ~ [sd,cp] ~").bank("RolandTR808").shape(.35).room(.4).gain(${gain}*.9), s("hh*8").bank("RolandTR808").ply("<1 1 2 [2 4]>").gain(saw.range(${hats}*.55, ${hats}).fast(4)), s("rim(3,8,<2 4>)").gain(.3), s("~ [~ oh] ~ [~ oh]").bank("RolandTR808").gain(.35)).lastOf(4, x=>x.fast(2)).orbit(1).play()
